integrity: Analytic proof and independent exact-rational least-squares comparisons; finite checker is supplementary. Prior constant-Jordan results and general eigenvalue-indeterminacy results are explicitly acknowledged; no historical-priority or independent proof certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; positive couplings in a single lower-bidiagonal chain; unrestarted GMRES, fixed first-coordinate initial residual; variations in coupling order do not represent symmetric permutation of a fixed matrix; no general ILU speedup assertion.
title: Exact GMRES ordering law and an isosingular exponential gap on weighted triangular chains
